reasons: Selector uses otel_metric_type="gauge" but postgresql.operations is defined as a sum and the dataset only has dataset_types [sum], so the selector matches no series.
The candidate wraps the counter in rate(...[$__rate_interval]), which changes the quantity from the raw Datadog value (avg of postgresql.rows_hot_updated) to a per-second rate.

The db and host template variables (prefixes db and host, default *) are dropped; they should become postgresql_database_name=~"$db" and host_name=~"$host" matchers, so the candidate's series set differs.
The grouping by db maps correctly to postgresql_database_name, and the operation="hot_upd" mapping to postgresql.operations is plausible, so the translated outcome is acceptable in principle.
